articles.title: Government working to utilise procurement process for promoting startups: DPIIT Secretary
articles.description: Elaborating on the move to enhance participation of startups in government procurement, DPIIT Additional Secretary Ateesh Kumar Singh said that there are already certain facilities available in the form of relaxations to the GFR (General Financial Rules).

articles.title: Brazil Opens Its First Battery Storage Auctions: Nearly 300 GW Vie for Entry [SMM Analysis]
articles.description: ANEEL has approved the tender documents for battery storage capacity auctions on December 2 and 4, with the domestic-content auction's ceiling price about 11.4% above the open auction's. ABSOLAR has also proposed to the re-elected government 8 GW of utility-scale storage by 2030 and an annual auction mechanism.

articles.title: Government working to utilise procurement process for promoting startups: DPIIT Secretary
articles.description: The Indian government aims to use procurement processes to promote startups within the nation effectively. Over 2.5 lakh startups exist in the country, with many in smaller towns. National Startup Awards 6.0 will award winning startups a cash prize of Rs 25 lakh across various categories. The initiative seeks to enhance support through mentorship, investor connections, and market access.
